description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald did not have an update on the status of Leonard Williams.
items.impact: Williams left Monday's loss against the Bears with a stinger. His status is uncertain heading into Week 9 against the Cardinals.
items.title: Leonard Williams (stinger) status uncertain

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Rashid Shaheed could return in Week 9 against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Shaheed did not play in Monday's loss against the Bears. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) hopeful to return in Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Uchenna Nwosu could return in Week 9 against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Nwosu did not play in Monday's loss against the Bears. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.
items.title: Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) could return in Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Charles Cross could return in Week 9 against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Cross did not play in Monday's loss against the Bears. He was given a 1-2 week timetable to return with an ankle sprain.
items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) could return in Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips practiced on Tuesday.
items.impact: It was reported on Monday that Phillips was trending in the right direction. He'll have a chance to return in Week 9 against the Broncos.
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) practices on side Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: AJ Dillon was back practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Dillon remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: AJ Dillon (ankle) practicing Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers designated OL Brady Christensen for return from IR.
items.impact: Christensen will have 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Brady Christensen designated to return from IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Loop did not practice on Tuesday with a groin injury.
items.impact: Loop remains a candidate to be placed on injured reserve.
items.title: Tyler Loop dealing with groin injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins remained sidelined from practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hawkins will likely miss another game on a short week.
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) not practicing Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Joe Fagnano was seen wearing an ankle guard/brace during Tuesday's practice.
items.impact: Fagnano remains hopeful to make his first career start on Thursday against the Jaguars. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice on Wednesday.
items.title: Joe Fagnano practices Tuesday wearing ankle guard/brace

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten was not seen practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Tuten was also listed as a DNP on Monday. With Jacksonville playing on Thursday, he'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Wednesday.
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (foot) not practicing Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals placed RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve.
items.impact: Love suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's win over the Cowboys. He is expected to be sidelined for the next 4-5 weeks. Pending the status of Bam Knight, Tyler Allgeier will figure to return to the lead role in the Cardinals backfield.
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens released FB Lucas Scott from the practice squad.
items.impact: Baltimore signed QB Austin Reed to the practice squad as the corresponding move.
items.title: Lucas Scott released by Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots released Elliott Davison.
items.impact: Davison will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Elliott Davison released by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants released Josh Tupou.
items.impact: Tupou will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Josh Tupou released by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Texans OL Blake Fisher is practicing this week.
items.impact: Fisher underwent thumb surgery for ulnar collateral ligament injury. His presence at practice is a good sign.
items.title: Blake Fisher (thumb) practicing this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers signed CB Jalyn Armour-Davis.
items.impact: Armour-Davis started 10 games for Tennessee last season before suffering a torn Achilles.
items.title: Jalyn Armour-Davis signs with Chargers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Jack Campbell is improving.
items.impact: Campbell suffered a neck injury early in the fourth quarter of Sunday's win over the Vikings. He remains in the hospital.
items.title: Jack Campbell (neck) improving per Dan Campbell

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bengals placed rookie DE Cashius Howell on injured reserve.
items.impact: Howell will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks.
items.title: Cashius Howell (wrist) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said he doesn't expect Cade Mays to practice on Wednesday or Thursday.
items.impact: Mays suffered a low ankle sprain on Sunday. He appears to be a longshot to play in Week 9 against the Dolphins.
items.title: Cade Mays (ankle) not expected to practice Wednesday or Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Kerby Joseph will not return in Week 9 against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Joseph will have to wait at least one more game to make his season debut. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) will not return Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions signed LB K.J. Britt to their active roster from the Patriots' practice squad.
items.impact: Britt will add depth in the linebacker room for Detroit.
items.title: K.J. Britt signs with Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vega Ioane is expected to play on Thursday against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Ioane will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday heading into a game on a short week for Baltimore.
items.title: Vega Ioane (knee) expected to play Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jake Moody is expected to start at kicker for the Ravens on Thursday against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Tyler Loop could be placed on injured reserve.
items.title: Jake Moody expected to start at kicker for Ravens Thursday

title: Fantasy Player News
